{{Quote|Oooo! Tough break for By't Distombe! Looks like that shortcut over the gas pool is going to cost him the race!''"<br/>&laquo;''No doubt about it, Fode! And Sebulba the Dug takes the lead!''&raquo;|quoteend=0|Fodesinbeed Annodue comments on By't Distombe's death|<ref name="Date" />}}
'''By't Disombe''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] who participated in the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
By't Distombe was a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] active<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" /> around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Approximately in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> he participated in the fifth race elimination final for the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|race]], held in the [[Phoebos Memorial Run/Legends|Phoebos Memorial Run]] course on<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" /> During the race, Distombe took the lead, but his fellow racer [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] overtook him and threw a bottle of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] at the Podracer's head. Distombe lost control and flew over a [[Methane/Legends|methane]] pool, in which a geyser erupted and ignited the engines of his [[By't Distombe's Podracer|Podracer]], making the vehicle explode and kill him.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|191|Distombe, By't}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Distombe was an [[Ear/Legends|earless]] [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" /> His first name was similar to the [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] Twi'lek name "Byt," which translated to "hammer." His surname was the Twi'lek clan name "Distombe," which translated to "strong."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Distombe used a white and red [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] with an open cockpit. During the Vinta Harvest Classic, he wore an orange [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], purple [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]], and at least one black [[Glove/Legends|glove]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
By't Distombe first appeared in the [[Star Wars (1998) 14|fourteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic|Star Wars]]'' comic series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Timothy Truman]], illustrated by [[Tom Lyle]],<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14" /> and published on [[January 26]], [[2000]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/99-102/Star-Wars-14Emissaries-to-Malastare-Part-2-of-6|text=Star Wars #14: Emissaries to Malastare (Part 2 of 6)}}</ref>
